verdict_scope: Existing independent VERIFY confirmed scoped nonvisual correction only; no new product validation or verdict change. Native/UI and canonical parent INDEX regeneration remain pending.

views: raw UTF-8 with replacement for binary scanning
whole existing gzip decoded content in memory
parsed JSON strings, keys and keyed string pairs unescaped
privacy.limits: Bounded signature inspection, not proof of absence. No arbitrary encoded/encrypted/obfuscated secret detection, unknown credential formats, unmarked private reasoning, nested serialized JSON guarantee or exhaustive personal-data detection. Local paths, task IDs and operational descriptions retained. No payload printed. Gzip is not redaction.
privacy.sensitive_retention: Signature candidates, if any, preserved whole under private/ (0700 parent, 0600 files), excluded from public list; original mode retained in manifest. No candidate files identified.

byte_preservation.compression: Deterministic lossless gzip wrapper, mtime=0 and no filename, for every original including both whole existing gzip states. Decode exactly one wrapper to recover original bytes; decode a second layer only to inspect an original .gz payload.
byte_preservation.filesystem_metadata: Public copies preserve full permission mode and nanosecond mtime. All original modes/mtimes/sizes/hashes and directory metadata recorded. Atime is not certified. Git cannot preserve full POSIX mode or mtime: apply original.mode_octal and original.mtime_ns after decoding.
byte_preservation.readable_selection: Additional unchanged UTF-8 copies <=65536 bytes, no controls except LF/tab, no trailing horizontal whitespace, final LF for nonempty files and no final blank line. Nonqualifying originals remain whole in gzip.

publication: Only literal repository-relative PUBLIC-stage-list.txt paths. No recursive staging. ARCHIVE-FILES.sha256 covers all allowlisted files except itself. Parent owns staging/commit.
